Let's call the information from the original surveys 

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

list_p <- c("tidyverse", "readxl", "readr",
           "haven")

sapply(list_p, function(x){ 
               if(!require(x, character.only = TRUE)){
               install.packages(x)
               library(x, character.only = TRUE)
               }
               })

```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

df <- read_dta("D:\\OneDrive - CGIAR\\R_projects\\Fertilice_right\\Data\\Anonimizado/mod_g2_long.dta") |> 
      dplyr::select(a10, g7_1, g10_c_1:g10_c_5, 
                    #g12_1_1:g12_1_5, 
                    cantidad_kilos_ha_1:cantidad_kilos_ha_5, 
                    N_TOTAL:K2O_TOTAL) |> 
      mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(., ""))) |>
      as.data.frame()
      
```

Select the products that you want to analyze

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

productos <- c("Triple 18", "Urea", "Sulfato de Amonio", 
               "Cloruro de Potasio", "NITRO XTENDÂ® 46 N", "Nutrimon", 
               "Ecofertil fase 3", "YaraVera AMIDAS", "Fertilizantes menores", 
               "DAP 18-46-0", "Patentkali")

df_prod <- df |> 
           pivot_longer(cols = c(g10_c_1:g10_c_5, cantidad_kilos_ha_1:cantidad_kilos_ha_5), 
                        names_to = c(".value", "index"), 
                        names_pattern = "(g10_c|cantidad_kilos_ha)_(\\d)")|>
           filter(!is.na(g10_c)) |>
           mutate(Product = tolower(trimws(g10_c)), 
                  quantity = cantidad_kilos_ha) |> 
           relocate(c(Product, quantity), .after = g7_1) |> 
           dplyr::select(-g10_c, -cantidad_kilos_ha) |> 
           as.data.frame()


matched_products <- df_prod |>
  mutate(
    best_match = map_chr(Product, \(x) {
      distances <- stringdist::stringdist(tolower(x), tolower(productos), method = "jw")
      best_index <- which.min(distances)
      best_score <- 1 - distances[best_index]
      if (best_score >= 0.8) productos[best_index] else NA_character_
    }),
    match_score = map_dbl(Product, \(x) {
      1 - min(stringdist::stringdist(tolower(x), tolower(productos), method = "jw"))
    })
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(best_match))

df_prod_wide <- matched_products |> 
                dplyr::select(ID = a10, Fert_event = g7_1, Product = best_match, quantity) |>
                group_by(ID, Fert_event, Product) |>
                summarise(quantity = sum(as.numeric(quantity), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
                pivot_wider(names_from = Product, 
                            values_from = quantity) |> 
                arrange(ID, Fert_event)

df_selected <- matched_products |> 
               dplyr::select(g7_1, Product, quantity) |> 
               filter(Product %in% c("triple 18", "urea", 
               "sulfato de amonio 21-0-0-24")) |> 
               group_by(ID = "a10", Fert_event = "g7_1", Product) |>
               summarise(quantity = sum(as.numeric(quantity), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
              pivot_wider(names_from = Product, 
                          values_from = quantity) |> 
              arrange(ID, Fert_event)


```

Determine the pecentage f times that the product wat applied

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

df_use <- matched_products |> 
          distinct(ID = a10, Fert_event = g7_1, 
                   Product = best_match) 

df_counts <- df_use |>
             group_by(Product, Fert_event) |>
             summarise(n_plots = n_distinct(ID), .groups = "drop")

# df_total <- df_use |> 
#             distinct(ID, Fert_event) |> 
#             count(Fert_event, name = "total_plots")
# 
# df_percentage <- df_counts |> 
#                  left_join(df_total, by = "Fert_event") |> 
#                  mutate(percentage = round(n_plots / total_plots * 100,1)) |>

# 
# df_wide_per <- df_percentage |> 
#                dplyr::select(-n_plots, -total_plots) |>
#                pivot_wider(names_from = Fert_event,
#                            names_prefix = "Event_",
#                            values_from = percentage, 
#                            values_fill = 0)

df_wide_counts <- df_counts |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Fert_event,
    names_prefix = "Event_",
    values_from = n_plots,
    values_fill = 0
  )

df_wide_per <- df_wide_counts |>
  mutate(
    total = rowSums(across(starts_with("Event_"))),
    across(starts_with("Event_"), ~ round(.x / total * 100, 1))) |>
  select(-total)

```

Let's make the selection of the most applied products

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false 

fert_counts <- df_selected |> 
               group_by(g7_1, Product) |> 
               summarize(count = n(), 
               .groups= "drop")

ggplot(fert_counts, aes(x = Product, y = count)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~ g7_1, ncol = 2) +
  theme_minimal()

```
